title: The Orchard Recall Chamber

features.name: memory blossom
features.desc-on-touch: a flowering moment frozen: you feel what the tree felt becoming bud, becoming flower, becoming fruit at once

features.name: pooled fruit-years
features.desc-on-touch: still water holding reflections of the same orchard at every harvest; you see yourself picking from seasons that haven't happened yet

features.name: stacked seasons
features.desc-on-touch: rows of harvest baskets from different years, each one heavier with what the fruit learned that year

features.name: root inscription
features.desc-on-touch: a glyph carved where tree meets earth, unreadable but warm; it names every variety that ever grew here

features.name: seed library
features.desc-on-touch: a wooden chest in the dusk-light, each drawer labeled with a year, each drawer holding seeds that are remembering what they became

inscription: fruit remembers being bud; bud remembers being flower; flower remembers being idea in the tree's slow mind

file.name: OrchardRecall_Varieties_PreservedNotes.txt
file.note: handwritten recipes and preservation notes, increasingly confused about whether we're preserving the fruit or it's preserving itself

exits.label: back toward the pantry where salt and yeast dream of earth
toward the market where fruit and seller have learned to trade memories instead of names
upslope toward groves where fruit trees gather to share what they've learned
